cb555372: ;
 .;This routine allows the user to delete patient incomplete records.
 .;The user is asked to select a patient incomplete record from a list
 .;and then confirm that they want to delete it.
 .;
 .;VARIABLES:
 .;DGJTDV - Medical Center Division
 .;DGJTIFN - Internal Entry Number of the patient incomplete record
 .;DGJTIFNO - Internal Entry Number of the patient incomplete record
 .;DGJDFNO - Internal Entry Number of the patient incomplete record
 .;DGJTYP - Type of patient incomplete record
 .;VALMY - List of selected entries
53d4647a: ;If the division is not defined, get the division from the MED CNTRL DVISION file
feaf2e0e: ;If no division is defined, get the first entry from the MEDICAL CENTER DIVISION file
6efbb0b5: ;If parameters are not set up for the division, display an error message and quit
b67bf5f2: ;Only show entries for the current division
c6eb13dd: ;Get the patient incomplete record to delete
5191592e: ;Loop through the selected entries and call EDIT^DGJTEE2 to update the record
8f2d8633: ;Rebuild and display the patient incomplete record list
5fd4514d: ;Confirm deletion and delete the record if confirmed
